issues.jp_before: 近所[きんじょ]{の|no-possessive}人[ひと]たち{と|to-reciprocal}協力[きょうりょく]し{て|te-sequence}、公園[こうえん]{を|o-object}掃除[そうじ]しました。
issues.problem: Distractor で is natural (近所の人たちで協力して = the neighbours cooperated as a group), which is close to the English meaning.
issues.action: Rewrote as 隣の人と協力して、家の前の雪かきをしました ('I worked with my neighbour to clear the snow...'), where で is plainly wrong.

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]{の|no-possessive}料理[りょうり]{は|wa-topic}昔[むかし]{と|to-reciprocal}変[か]わらない味[あじ]です。
issues.problem: Distractor に is acceptable (昔に変わらない味 is an established set expression).
issues.action: Replaced distractor に with へ (d: を, で, へ).

issues.jp_before: クラス{の|no-possessive}みんな{と|to-reciprocal}話[はな]し合[あ]っ{て|te-sequence}、文化祭[ぶんかさい]{の|no-possessive}予定[よてい]{を|o-object}決[き]めました。
issues.problem: クラスのみんなで話し合って is equally natural with nearly the same meaning, so the focus slot had two answers (and で belongs to a different skill).
issues.action: Changed the partner to 担任の先生 ('our homeroom teacher'), where で is impossible.
